Rayhorodok Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Rayhorodok's Jewish community, settled in the early 18th century, peaked at 946 people (46 percent of the town) in 1897 before halving during the interwar period; 125 were murdered after the German arrival in 1941. Today the cemetery consists of two separate areas of Jewish graves, and it is unclear whether this reflects one originally larger site or two distinct smaller ones — local testimony conflicts, with one resident recalling tombstones between the two areas in childhood, and another recalling a house standing there instead.
